rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
rules.vi: Instrumen khusus dengan hak lebih sempit, atau hanya pasal tertentu dari hukum umum
rules.n: Dedicated decree-law; the general labor law (FDL 33/2021) excludes domestic workers. Scope limited to occupations listed in the Executive Regulations.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib dan tersedia dalam bahasa yang dipahami pekerja
rules.n: Employment Agreement on the Ministry form, copy delivered to the worker; contracts and forms in Arabic plus a language the worker understands.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.n: No statutory minimum wage. Art. 28(3) sets a minimum income for the employer, not a wage floor.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
rules.vi: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura
rules.n: Monthly wage in UAE dirhams within 10 days of the due date, proved by receipt; deductions capped at one quarter. Payment through the Wage Protection System is required for 5 domestic occupations and voluntary for the other 14.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
rules.vi: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: Daily rest of at least 12 hours, 8 of them consecutive (so at most 12 hours of work a day); no weekly limit and no overtime rule.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Weekly rest provided but it may be worked for pay or another day, or is shorter
rules.vi: Istirahat mingguan ada tetapi boleh diganti uang atau hari lain, atau lebih pendek
rules.n: Paid weekly rest day; the worker may be required to work it for another rest day or a day's wage, but not on more than two consecutive rest days in two weeks unless agreed.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: At least 30 days' paid annual leave; return ticket every two years.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
rules.vi: Hak tegas, atau penahanan oleh pemberi kerja dilarang dengan sanksi
rules.n: Employer must ensure the worker's right to keep their own identification documents; withholding them carries a fine of AED 500.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan
rules.n: Employer must provide suitable accommodation; no rule on living out.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
rules.n: Transfer during the contract needs the employer's written consent and Ministry approval; without consent only after a judicial decision that the employer breached its obligations, or immediately in cases of assault (reported to the authorities). No exit permit is required.
rules.s: FDL 9/2022 arts 20-21; Ministerial Resolution 674/2022 art. 2; Cabinet Resolution 106/2022

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
rules.vi: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen
rules.n: Agencies may not demand or accept any commission or expenses from the worker; employers may not take any amount from the worker.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
rules.vi: Agen berizin dan bertanggung jawab kepada pekerja (pengembalian, biaya pulang atau tanggung renteng)
rules.n: Licensing by the Ministry; agency bears return costs and is the employer under temporary employment.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Inspection of households allowed under stated safeguards
rules.vi: Pengawasan rumah tangga diizinkan dengan pengaman yang ditetapkan
rules.n: Inspectors may enter the employer's home with the owner's or the Public Prosecution's permission, on a complaint or reasonable evidence.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya
rules.n: Ministry settlement within two weeks; the Ministry decides claims up to AED 50,000 with review by the courts (as amended in 2023); worker lawsuits are fee-exempt and urgent; three-month limit after the end of employment.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.v: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
rules.vi: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
rules.n: Employer bears medical care or health insurance and work-injury compensation; 30 days' sick leave (15 full pay, 15 half pay). No maternity leave, unemployment insurance or pension. End-of-service gratuity: art. 22 leaves it to the Cabinet and no resolution has been issued (checked 12 Nov. 2026); the often-cited 14 days a year came from the repealed Federal Law 10/2017.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.n: Sexual harassment, forced labor and discrimination prohibited in recruitment; employer must treat the worker with dignity and protect bodily safety.

rules.gi: United Arab Emirates · pekerja rumah tangga
rules.vi: Tidak ada hak yang diakui hukum
rules.n: Not addressed in the decree-law; UAE labor law does not provide for trade unions.

decisions.nm: Employer stopped paying salary without formally ending the contract
decisions.ct: Abu Dhabi Court of Cassation (as reported)
decisions.pe: A company stopped paying an employee from mid-2025 but never told her in writing that her job had ended. The court said she was still employed and ordered the company to pay her wages, gratuity and leave.
decisions.pi: Sebuah perusahaan berhenti menggaji karyawan sejak pertengahan 2025 tetapi tidak pernah memberi tahu secara tertulis bahwa pekerjaannya berakhir. Pengadilan menyatakan ia masih bekerja dan memerintahkan perusahaan membayar gaji, pesangon, dan cuti.

decisions.nm: Waiver of end-of-service benefits signed during employment
decisions.pe: An employee had signed a paper giving up end-of-service pay while still working. The court said such a waiver does not count and ordered the benefits paid.
decisions.pi: Seorang karyawan menandatangani surat melepaskan pesangon saat masih bekerja. Pengadilan menyatakan pelepasan itu tidak berlaku dan memerintahkan pesangon dibayar.

decisions.nm: Gratuity before one year of service
decisions.pe: A worker who left before a year asked for end-of-service pay. The court said the law then in force required a full year. The 2021 law keeps a one-year threshold. [Check.]
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja yang berhenti sebelum setahun meminta pesangon. Pengadilan menyatakan UU yang berlaku saat itu mensyaratkan setahun penuh. UU 2021 tetap memakai batas satu tahun. [Periksa.]

decisions.nm: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates (ICERD), Provisional Measures, Order of 23 July 2018
decisions.pe: Interstate case under the race discrimination convention (ICERD). The Court ordered interim measures, including that families separated by measures based on nationality be reunited and that affected students and litigants keep access to education and courts. Part of a series with the CERD decisions of 2019 and the…
decisions.pi: Perkara antarnegara berdasarkan Konvensi Penghapusan Diskriminasi Rasial (ICERD). Mahkamah memerintahkan tindakan sementara, antara lain agar keluarga yang terpisah akibat tindakan berdasarkan kewarganegaraan disatukan kembali, serta agar pelajar dan pihak berperkara tetap dapat mengakses pendidikan dan pengadilan.

decisions.nm: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates (ICERD), Provisional Measures, Order of 14 June 2019
decisions.pe: The Court declined the respondent's request for provisional measures against the applicant. Procedural step in the same ICERD case.
decisions.pi: Mahkamah menolak permohonan tindakan sementara yang diajukan termohon terhadap pemohon. Langkah prosedural dalam perkara ICERD yang sama.

decisions.nm: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates, Decision on Jurisdiction (inter-state communication)
decisions.ct: UN Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination
decisions.pe: The Committee held that it had jurisdiction over the inter-state communication and rejected the objection that distinctions based on current nationality fall outside the convention. Key question: does ICERD protect non-citizens against nationality-based measures? Compare the ICJ judgment of 2021, which read 'national…
decisions.pi: Komite menyatakan berwenang atas komunikasi antarnegara ini dan menolak keberatan bahwa pembedaan berdasarkan kewarganegaraan saat ini berada di luar cakupan konvensi. Bandingkan dengan putusan ICJ 2021 yang menafsirkan 'asal kebangsaan' secara lebih sempit.

decisions.nm: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates, Decision on Admissibility (inter-state communication)
decisions.ct: UN Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination
decisions.pe: Companion decision on admissibility, addressing the objections on exhaustion of domestic remedies and on parallel proceedings before the ICJ. To be confirmed against the official text.
decisions.pi: Putusan pendamping tentang dapat diterimanya komunikasi, menyangkut keberatan soal upaya hukum domestik dan perkara paralel di ICJ. Perlu dicocokkan dengan teks resmi.

decisions.nm: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates (ICERD), Preliminary Objections, Judgment of 4 February 2021
decisions.pe: The Court upheld a preliminary objection and found it lacked jurisdiction, holding that 'national origin' in ICERD does not include current nationality. Reads the convention differently from the CERD Committee's 2019 decision; a central text on how far ICERD protects non-citizens.
decisions.pi: Mahkamah menerima keberatan awal dan menyatakan tidak berwenang, dengan pertimbangan bahwa 'asal kebangsaan' dalam ICERD tidak mencakup kewarganegaraan saat ini. Tafsir ini berbeda dari putusan Komite CERD 2019.
